learning_outcomes.text: Develop practical solutions for the design and implementation of network topology of communication systems.
Ensure transmitted data against unauthorized access.

syllabus_topics: Signal transfer, introduction to digital communication, ISO/OSI model
Physical layer, transmission media, types of electrical signals
Optical data communications, transmitters, receivers, transmission cables and connectors
Data transmission security, error detection, correction, encryption
Higher layer of model, features, services
Overview of industrial buses, examples of their solutions, network topology
Industrial ASi bus concept, integration of security
bibliography: Wilamowski B.M., Irwin J. D.: Industrial Communications Systems, CRC Presss 2017
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
